onboarding.step0Title: Know where your day actually goes
onboarding.step0Desc: EchoFocus times the tab in front of you, turns it into a focus score, and writes a short daily read on your patterns. No timer to start, no log to keep.
onboarding.step0Card0Desc: Starts the moment you open a tab and pauses when you step away.
onboarding.step0Card1Desc: Browsing data is written to local extension storage, not to a server.
onboarding.step0Card2Desc: A focus score, your top sites, and an AI snapshot of the day.
onboarding.step1Title: Tracking that needs nothing from you
onboarding.step1Desc: Browse the way you normally do. EchoFocus measures the active tab, pauses on idle or a locked screen, and sorts every site into one of three buckets.
onboarding.step1ScoreNote: Your score is focused minutes as a share of focused plus break minutes — neutral time never counts against you. Any site can be recategorized in Settings.
onboarding.step2Title: Your browsing history never leaves this device
onboarding.step2Desc: This is the part most trackers get wrong, so here is exactly what happens to your data.
onboarding.step2Stay0Desc: Every domain, duration, and category lives in the extension's own storage on this computer. Nothing is uploaded.
onboarding.step2Stay1Title: Sent for AI analysis: a daily summary
onboarding.step2Stay1Desc: Only aggregated numbers — domain names, minutes per domain, and your category totals for the day. About twenty lines of text.
onboarding.step2Footnote: AI analysis is optional, and you can export everything as JSON or erase every byte from the Privacy tab in Settings.
onboarding.step3Desc: Pin the EchoFocus icon to your toolbar and today's score is one click away. Everything below is optional.
onboarding.step3Unlock0Desc: Today, trends, and insights on any device
onboarding.step3Unlock1Desc: A short read on your patterns, kept day by day
onboarding.step3Unlock2Desc: Watch your focus score move across weeks
onboarding.step3Footnote: Signing in syncs daily summaries only — never your raw browsing data.
